proposed_from.topic: Conditional efficiency bound for staggered triple differences. In an iid fixed-T panel with adoption cohort G, eligibility S, covariates X, overlap, no anticipation, and the target-indexed covariate-conditional DDD parallel-gap restrictions of Ortiz-Villavicencio--Sant'Anna, fix finitely many group-time ATTs and a prespecified aggregate omega. Use every admissible clean comparison cohort. Derive the full observed-law tangent space and canonical gradient. Prove, rather than assume, that the efficient gradient is the joint OVS score vector Psi weighted by b*(x)=Gamma(x)^(-1)A{A'Gamma(x)^(-1)A}^(-1)omega, with the correct operator form for singular fixed-rank cases. Construct an attaining cross-fitted estimator under explicit overlap, conditional-eigenvalue, L4, nuisance and learned-weight product-rate conditions, with pointwise Wald inference. Characterize exactly when OVS's published loading and the parent's best constant joint loading satisfy the pointwise projection equations. Give a bounded open binary-covariate family where conditional weighting strictly beats every constant loading, and pointwise inference for the efficiency gap away from equality. Integrate the method as an optional backend for CRAN triplediff; do not call score-class projection semiparametric efficiency before tangent exhaustion is proved. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: The presolver derived Var{b(X)'Psi}=Var{omega'h(X)}+E[b(X)'Gamma(X)b(X)] and its pointwise constrained optimizer, including the singular operator condition. A legal binary-X mixture of the parent's bounded witness with rho_x=xr makes every constant loading choose q=0 while q*(x)=xr omega_2/2; the exact gain is 3r^2 omega_2^2/32, equal to 3/512 at r=omega_2=1/2, with separated conditional eigenvalues. Current searches distinguish overidentified staggered DDD from just-identified DDD EIFs and efficient DiD. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove local full-data-to-observed equivalence and tangent exhaustion: every regular aggregate gradient must differ from a fixed pairwise gradient exactly by the closure of measurable conditional clean-comparison contrasts. Without this theorem, b*(X)'Psi is only optimal in a chosen score family. Then control shared-cell covariance and learned-weight remainders. EARLY KILL TEST: Symbolically differentiate the finite-support binary-X three-score submodel under both conditional clean-cohort equalities, compute its complete tangent matrix, and verify that the projected gradient is b*(X)'Psi with gain 3/512. Any extra variance-reducing direction, missing gradient, or omitted compatibility restriction kills the canonical-gradient claim. proposed_from.novelty_justification: The precise novelty is not inverse conditional covariance by itself. OVS's published result minimizes an unconditional covariance over constant weights separately for each group--time target. Chen--Sant'Anna--Xie prove the analogous full efficiency result for DiD only after an observable-law equivalence theorem: their Theorem 3.2 derives the staggered-DiD conditional efficient influence function and bound, and Theorem 4.1 proves estimator attainment. This proposal's strict delta is the DDD-specific equivalence and tangent-exhaustion theorem for simultaneous eligibility-gap restrictions, followed by a joint cross-target conditional projection with shared-cell covariance, a fixed-rank quotient formula, perturbation-derived learned-loading rates, an attaining estimator, globally defined Moore--Penrose comparator diagnostics, and pointwise inference for the conditional-versus-constant efficiency loss. The arXiv target search through September 10, 2026 found no closer all-clean-cohort staggered-DDD efficiency paper; Hsieh's new stacked DDD paper expressly trades efficiency for transparent fixed weights, and Akbari--Kiyavash--Ghassami remains a basic just-identified DDD result.

seed_details.title: Observed-law tangent exhaustion and the conditional efficiency bound
seed_details.anchor_location: Theorem 4.1 and Remark 4.6 construct and optimally combine recentered clean-comparison scores; the conclusion explicitly leaves overidentified DDD efficiency open.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace OVS's unconditional GMM minimization by a two-sided full-data-extension theorem and an exact tangent-orthocomplement calculation before projection.
seed_details.destination_search: A September 10, 2026 arXiv query for triple differences and efficiency returned Hsieh, Caron, Akbari--Kiyavash--Ghassami, and Borusyak--Jaravel--Spiess, but no all-clean-cohort OVS tangent-space result.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Immediate from Chen--Sant'Anna--Xie because DDD merely adds an eligibility difference to staggered DiD.
seed_details.rebuttal: The first missing step is not matrix algebra: eligibility creates coupled observable equalities, target-share derivatives, and shared four-cell histories whose full-data extendability and tangent exhaustion are absent from the DiD theorem.

seed_details.title: Quotient-space canonical gradients under redundant clean comparisons
seed_details.anchor_location: Theorem 5.2 and its proof replace ordinary inverse-covariance weighting by a generalized inverse when conditional moments are singular.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Translate Newey's consistency equation \(G(x)=V(x)F(x)\) into the DDD affine constraint and prove null-coordinate invariance and measurability of the conditional quotient.
seed_details.destination_search: The exact triple-difference efficiency search found no fixed-rank singular DDD result, while OVS retains only noncollinear scores with nonsingular unconditional blocks.
seed_details.cynical_objection: This is a routine insertion of a Moore--Penrose inverse.
seed_details.rebuttal: An unqualified pseudoinverse formula can be wrong; the contribution is the range geometry, quotient uniqueness, measurable fixed-rank selection, and DDD compatibility with shared score coordinates.
seed_details.disposition: dropped as a standalone seed and absorbed into the chosen kernel

seed_details.title: Limit theory for a learned conditional shared-cell loading
seed_details.anchor_location: Theorems 3 and 5 derive the basic panel-DDD EIF and a cross-fitted product-rate central limit theorem.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: After the basic DDD score expansion, retain cross-target shared-cell covariances and bound the loading-error times nuisance-error remainder under exact affine feasibility.
seed_details.destination_search: The all-cohort search found OVS's parametric first steps and Chen--Sant'Anna--Xie's DiD estimator, but no learned conditional staggered-DDD covariance weight.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Generic double machine learning already gives the central limit theorem.
seed_details.rebuttal: Generic DML does not supply orthogonality for a law-dependent constrained covariance loading or control residual reuse across target coordinates; those terms must be expanded from the exact DDD score.
seed_details.disposition: dropped as a standalone seed and absorbed into the chosen kernel

seed_details.title: Exact equality frontier and inference for lost conditional precision
seed_details.anchor_location: Equation 4.10, Remark 4.6, and the conclusion define the constant componentwise GMM benchmark without a pointwise equality characterization.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the unconditional GMM normal equation by \(N^{\prime}\Gamma(X)b=0\) almost surely and differentiate the optimized variance-loss functional.
seed_details.destination_search: Chen--Sant'Anna--Xie establishes covariate-dependent DiD weights, and Sant'Anna--Xu gives a Hausman test, but neither source studies inference for the optimized DDD efficiency gap.
seed_details.cynical_objection: The equality condition is just the first-order condition of a quadratic program.
seed_details.rebuttal: The theorem distinguishes pointwise from unconditional cancellation, connects both named DDD loadings to the full bound, and adds a pathwise one-step limit for the optimized loss away from its degenerate boundary.
seed_details.disposition: survived Step 1 and was folded into the chosen paper as a secondary theorem package

seed_details.title: Observed-data efficiency with staggered DDD and compositional change
seed_details.anchor_location: Theorems 4 and 6 derive repeated-cross-section DDD influence functions with and without compositional stability; the conclusion names multiple periods as future work.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace within-unit long differences by treatment-time--eligibility cell scores and characterize the enlarged sampling-time tangent components before all-cohort projection.
seed_details.destination_search: OVS and Chen--Sant'Anna--Xie both leave repeated cross-sections or unbalanced panels open, and Sant'Anna--Xu covers only two-period DiD compositional change.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Stacking the published repeated-cross-section DDD EIF across cohorts settles the problem.
seed_details.rebuttal: Stacking does not exhaust the observable sampling-time restrictions or determine covariance created by shared sampled cells under compositional change.
seed_details.disposition: survived Step 1 as the alternate; not chosen because it compounds two unresolved tangent problems

seed_details.title: Minimax rate frontier under vanishing clean-cell overlap
seed_details.anchor_location: Assumption 3.2 imposes fixed overlap for every clean cohort, and Theorem 4.1 works in the regular root-\(n\) regime.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Let the minimum retained conditional cell probability decay and derive the effective information of the four-cell transported residual before constructing upper and lower bounds.
seed_details.destination_search: ArXiv searches combining triple difference with minimax or overlap returned no direct result.
seed_details.cynical_objection: This is the standard weak-overlap rate with four propensity factors.
seed_details.rebuttal: Shared comparison cells and optimal cohort selection can change the least-favorable direction, but the rate parameter is not yet uniquely specified by the OVS model.
seed_details.disposition: dropped after deepening because the structural regime parameter is underdetermined

seed_details.title: Policy learning from heterogeneous staggered-DDD effects
seed_details.anchor_location: Theorem 3.2 identifies group--time ATT effects but does not identify individual policy value over eligibility rules.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the fixed aggregate by a welfare score for a covariate-dependent eligibility policy and verify that the DDD assumptions identify that score.
seed_details.destination_search: An arXiv query combining triple difference and policy returned no DDD policy-learning theorem, but it also revealed no published identification bridge from group--time ATT to counterfactual policy value.
seed_details.cynical_objection: The stated DDD restrictions identify only effects on realized treated eligibles, not welfare under reassignment.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds without an additional transport assumption, so the seed is rejected rather than padded with a stronger assumption.

seed_details.title: Permutation inversion for staggered-DDD counterfactual paths
seed_details.anchor_location: Sections 3 and 6 define pairwise stacks and asymptotic cluster-robust inference but provide no finite-sample symmetry argument.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the asymptotic stack central limit theorem by a group action that preserves the DDD null within every stack.
seed_details.destination_search: An arXiv query combining triple difference and conformal returned zero results.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Conditional parallel gaps do not imply exchangeability of cohort or eligibility labels, so the required permutation orbit is invalid.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds in the maintained model; an added symmetry assumption would define a different design, so the seed is rejected.

seed_details.title: Critical-\(\delta\) sensitivity for conditional DDD parallel gaps
seed_details.anchor_location: Assumption 3.3 imposes the clean-cohort parallel-gap equality exactly; the paper offers pretrend diagnostics rather than a violation frontier.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Introduce a norm-bounded conditional violation shared across comparison cohorts, derive aggregate endpoints, and solve for the smallest radius at which the ATT sign changes.
seed_details.destination_search: An arXiv query combining triple difference and sensitivity found only an unrelated group-heterogeneity paper and no critical-radius bound for the OVS staggered design.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Rambachan--Roth sensitivity applies after relabeling the DDD gap as a trend.
seed_details.rebuttal: The OVS system has overlapping clean-cohort equalities and a fixed aggregate, so sharp joint violations require compatibility across shared histories; nevertheless this is a separate identification paper rather than the requested efficiency kernel.
seed_details.disposition: dropped after ranking because it is a separate partial-identification paper
